# `jouet rule promote`

- **Usage:** `jouet rule promote [--reason <TEXT>] <NAME>`

Switch a rule of yours from warn to deny

Only rules in ~/.config/jouet/rules: built-in rules are part of jouet, and a repository's change through a reviewed PR. Logged in `jouet rule log`.

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — The rule's name

## Flags
- **`--reason <TEXT>`** — Why, for the log
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
